title: UMich Final Sentiment in Focus as EZ Stagflation Deepens — PMI Shock Sets Divergence Theme
edito: Stagflation day. The EZ just printed its worst PMI in 17 months while oil holds above 02 on Hormuz escalation. The ECB is cornered into a June hike it can't afford, and the Fed is on hold with Warsh waiting in the wings. Bear steepening is the regime — carry-positive curve trades are the expression. The council retained 17 of 23 trades, with the Bund 2s10s steepener as top conviction.

title: Flash PMI Day: EZ Slides Into Contraction as US Manufacturing Surges — Stagflation Trade Goes Global
edito: PMI divergence day. The Eurozone just printed its worst composite reading in 17 months while US manufacturing surged to a near-4-year high. This isn't just a data surprise — it's a structural split that redefines CB policy paths, curve trades, and cross-currency positioning for the quarter. The council retained 15 of 24 trades, with the ECB-Fed 2Y spread and Bund steepener as top conviction.
